desc: Designed for youths and smaller framed adults, our very popular Bantam™ models feature more compact dimensions than our standard field models. Stocks are 1"shorter (13"LOP) than our typical standard lengths, E-Z Reach™ forearms are easier to grasp and are positioned closer to the shooter, making it easier for shorter arms to cycle the action. Shorter barrel lengths are selected for lighter weight and comfortable balance but they are still interchangeable with all our standard 20 gauge, 6-shot capacity 500® models.
